name: delivery-dashboard
description: Live run dashboard, Mermaid diagram viewer, and Markdown document viewer, rendered inline as an MCP App.

project_directory.title: Project directory
project_directory.description: The git worktree this dashboard reports on. QA evidence paths are resolved against it, and anything outside it is refused. Leave unset to use the server's working directory.

state_directory.title: Run state directory
state_directory.description: Where run files are stored. Leave unset to use a per-project folder under your Claude configuration directory.

tools.name: open_dashboard
tools.description: Show the run dashboard for this project.

tools.name: start_run
tools.description: Start tracking a run and declare its stages.

tools.name: record_prompt
tools.description: Append a prompt to a run's prompt history.

tools.name: set_run_context
tools.description: Persist the change kind, the approval decision, and the handoff marker.

tools.name: update_stage
tools.description: Update a stage's status, output, links, QA scenarios and monitoring findings.

tools.name: finish_run
tools.description: Close a run with a final status and summary.

tools.name: get_run
tools.description: Fetch one run in full, with insight and context summaries.

tools.name: render_diagram
tools.description: Render Mermaid source in the diagram viewer.

tools.name: render_markdown
tools.description: Render a Markdown document in the document viewer.

tools.name: export_report
tools.description: Write a run's report to disk as Markdown or self-contained HTML.
